name: Curated ASMR tapping v1

sources.creator: ASMR Bakery
sources.title: ASMR Sleepy Slow Tapping | Metal Sounds (No Talking)

adaptations: Independently curated source intervals and 80/10/10 within-recording split, not recovered author selections
Three-second guard gaps and non-overlapping three-second clips; held-out sequences share the recording session
Metal spoon replaces the paper steel bar; material names are source descriptions, not measured physical properties
Audio is decoded from public AAC streams; left channel is used for fitting and original stereo/video is retained
No force, geometry or calibrated stiffness labels; video frames are retained but not model inputs
quality_review: Chapter descriptions and five sampled video frames per selected interval checked for object continuity; no per-impact annotations or cross-session generalization claim
